name: Fading Hearts Parallel
source:
After a terrible incident I moved somewhere far away...

Lost in a paradise of fictional 2D characters I can start to forget...

But my old ways still lie dormant within me...

They start to awaken when history starts to repeat...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090505175117/http://sakurariver.ca/main/fading-hearts-parallel]Sakura River[/url]]
translation:
那场可怕的事件过后，我搬到了很远的地方…

沉浸在虚构二维角色构成的乐园里，我终于可以开始遗忘…

但过去的习性依然沉睡在我心中…

当历史开始重演，它们也随之逐渐苏醒…

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090505175117/http://sakurariver.ca/main/fading-hearts-parallel]Sakura River[/url]]
